component.name: Jade Browser
component.summary: A faster, more private web browser

description.p: Jade is a web browser built on Chromium that focuses on speed, privacy and a clean reading experience.

ul.li: Shows web pages in dark mode
Turns on Turbo, which makes pages load faster and use less data

description.p: Turbo works by fetching some of the images, scripts and stylesheets on the pages you visit through Jade's servers, which compress them before they reach you. It can be turned off in Jade's options.

Ad blocking uses block lists that Jade downloads from its servers. An optional VPN, off until you turn it on, routes your browsing through Jade's VPN servers. Its UK location is free; the US and Switzerland locations need a paid subscription. A reader mode is also available.

Jade includes the Clerkenwell Coupons extension, which finds and applies discount codes at checkout. A list of the stores it covers is kept on your device and updated daily, and it asks the Clerkenwell Coupons service for codes only on the basket or checkout pages of those stores. When a page shows which shop software it runs on, or that it is behind a bot-protection service, the extension also reports the site's address, that software or service, its basket link and your browser version, to build its directory of stores. You can remove the extension from the Extensions page.
